All exported functions in the `admetshiny` package, organized by category.

---

## Application

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `run_app()` | Launch the interactive Shiny application |

---

## Drug-Likeness Filters

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `lipinskiFilter()` | Lipinski Rule-of-Five filter (MW, LogP, HBA, HBD) |
| `ghoseFilter()` | Ghose qualifying range filter (MW, MR, LogP, atoms) |
| `veberFilter()` | Veber oral bioavailability filter (RB, TPSA, HBA+HBD) |
| `eganFilter()` | Egan PSA-LogP filter (TPSA, LogP) |
| `mueggeFilter()` | Muegge pharmacophore filter (MW, LogP, TPSA, HBA, HBD, RB) |
| `applyFilters()` | Apply multiple filters in sequence |
| `computeViolationColumns()` | Compute or preserve violation columns from properties |

---

## Data Normalization & CDK

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `mapADMETColumns()` | Map any user dataset to standard column schema |
| `mapCDKDescriptors()` | Map CDK descriptor output to standard schema |
| `calcCDKDescriptors()` | Calculate descriptors from SMILES via CDK (requires rcdk) |
| `getSmilesFromIdentifiers()` | Retrieve SMILES from PubChem via names, CAS, or InChIKeys |
| `computeADMETProperties()` | Compute BOILED-Egg ADMET classification (GI, BBB, Pgp) |

---

## Visualization

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `plotBoiledEgg()` | BOILED-Egg model plot (HIA + BBB prediction) |
| `plotMW()` | Molecular weight distribution histogram |
| `plotTPSA()` | TPSA distribution histogram |
| `plotLogP()` | LogP distribution histogram |
| `plotCorrHeatmap()` | Correlation heatmap with Pearson/Spearman + significance |
| `plotClusterHeatmap()` | Cluster heatmap with dendrogram (requires pheatmap) |
| `plotHistogramCustom()` | Customizable histogram with auto test selection |
| `plotViolin()` | Violin plot with auto Wilcoxon/Kruskal-Wallis |
| `plotPCA()` | PCA chemical space with PERMANOVA + loading arrows |
| `plotTSNE()` | t-SNE chemical space with PERMANOVA (requires Rtsne) |
| `plotUMAP()` | UMAP chemical space with PERMANOVA (requires uwot) |
| `plotParallel()` | Parallel coordinates with PERMANOVA (requires GGally) |
| `plotRadar()` | Radar chart of physicochemical profile (requires fmsb) |
| `plotTanimoto()` | Tanimoto/AGNES structural similarity dendrogram (requires rcdk) |

---

## Plot Customization

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `palette_selector_ui()` | Shiny UI element for colour palette selection |
| `apply_palette()` | Apply a colour palette to a ggplot2 object |

---

## Report Generation

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `generateReport()` | Generate comprehensive report (HTML, PDF, Word) |
